name: Inventory Movement
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-FLW-012 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-OBJ-020 remains a required typed reference rather than an approved parent until joint boundary review.

Boundary hold: product, lot, serial, handling unit, location, stock position, order, task, shipment, trace, ledger, valuation, accounting, document, observation, incident and evidence remain external masters.
Assertion-kind hold: request, plan, reservation, physical execution, observation, posting, balance, correction and reconciliation must remain distinguishable.
Authority hold: authoritative posting, reversal and resulting balance require the external inventory master or ledger authority.
Terminology hold: movement, transfer, transaction, issue, receipt, adjustment, task and posting are profile-specific terms.
Profile hold: warehouse, manufacturing, retail, healthcare, customs, dangerous-goods, safety, accounting, valuation, privacy, licensing and retention profiles need independent validation.
Evidence hold: one scan, count, document, shipment event or posting reference does not alone prove balance, ownership, custody, availability, quality or financial value.
Interoperability hold: all GS1, UBL, UN/CEFACT, ISA-95, IEC 62264, unit, provenance and quality projections require exact release pins, conformance tests and semantic-loss declarations.
Completeness hold: the 24-source draft is broad but does not claim universal industry, legal, operational or accounting coverage.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
